description_html:
• The UGREEN angled HDMI cable has been designed with wall-mounted TVs in mind. With it, you can connect, among others, a console, DVD or laptop. The product supports a resolution of up to 4Kx2K, which ensures excellent image quality. A copper conductor is responsible for its reliable operation.
  • Connector: 24K gold-plated
  • Wire: Tinned oxygen-free copper
  • suitable weight
  • item package weight: 100.0
description_text:
• The UGREEN angled HDMI cable has been designed with wall-mounted TVs in mind. With it, you can connect, among others, a console, DVD or laptop. The product supports a resolution of up to 4Kx2K, which ensures excellent image quality. A copper conductor is responsible for its reliable operation.
• Connector: 24K gold-plated

description_html_ar:
صُمم كابل HDMI بزاوية من UGREEN خصيصًا لأجهزة التلفزيون المثبتة على الحائط. يمكنك من خلاله توصيل أجهزة مثل وحدة التحكم، أو مشغل أقراص DVD، أو اللاب توب

يدعم المنتج دقة تصل إلى 4Kx2K، مما يضمن جودة صورة ممتازة.
